summary: Implementation meets all FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 acceptance criteria. Build passes, 235 tests pass (61 new). Server-side flow controller follows sync.ts pattern, UI components follow SyncPanel/AuditViewer patterns. One warning: VersionPreview fetches /rule-engine/flows/:id?version=X but no CMS proxy route exists for this — engine's getFlow doesn't support version param either. Preview of non-active versions will 404. This was acknowledged in FEAT-002 step 5 as 'may need to add endpoint'. Core functionality (version list, comparison, rollback) works.

findings.message: VersionPreview fetches /rule-engine/flows/:id?version=X but this endpoint doesn't exist in CMS routes, and engine's getFlow doesn't support version query param. Preview of non-active versions will fail with 404. Consider adding a getFlowVersion route or modifying engine to accept ?version.
